title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the wave function is unchanged, selecting option (b).

title: Understanding of Spin
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of total spin states and their implications for wave function symmetry.

title: Explanation of Parity
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of parity and how it relates to the symmetry of the wave function.

title: Clarity of Reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear and logical reasoning process leading to the final answer.

title: Common Misconception
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid the common error of stating that the wave function changes sign or becomes a different function.
